subject: Last-minute time change
text: Quick heads-up! The venue just moved our slot to 4:15 instead of 6:30, and it’s happening sooner than we thought. I can meet you outside the side door at three fifty if that helps. Otherwise, I’ll text when I arrive. If you can swing it, I’ll be there by four. If not, no stress, but I’d love to grab seats while they’re still open. Shoot me a message if you want me to save you one. Fingers crossed this change works for you.
